<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Availability, price, and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Parts delivery batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ContractProject" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Task_SendOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDeliveries" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="EventSubprocessStart_Delivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapestReorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastestReorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Project" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive shop offers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateParts" name="Allocate parts using the cheapest offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateShopLists" name="Create an order list for each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrders" name="Send parts orders" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BuildingStarted" name="Building started"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Project" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_SendOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="EndEvent_BuildingStarted"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubprocess_LaterDeliveries" name="Handle later delivery batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="EventSubprocessStart_Delivery" name="Parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock for delivered parts"/>
      <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockThresholds" name="Check stock thresholds" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoThreshold"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder from the cheapest shop" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder from the fastest shop" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
      <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdJoin" name="Join applicable stock actions" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StockActions" name="Stock actions complete"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoThreshold" name="No reorder threshold reached"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_01" sourceRef="EventSubprocessStart_Delivery" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_02" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Cheapest" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Fastest" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoThreshold" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="EndEvent_NoThreshold"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cheapest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fastest_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Join" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_StockActions"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
